searches.description: Keep your counter moving. Start a search or pick up the latest workshop requests.
searches.channels-body: Bring your team's web searches and your workshops' WhatsApp requests together.
searches.channel-note: Every request stays in your company's shared search history.
searches.desk-body: A shared parts desk for the people behind the counter.
searches.queue-description: Every request, from the counter or WhatsApp, in one place.
searches.filter-page: Filter this page by plate or vehicle
searches.no-matches-body: Clear the page filters or try another page.
searches.empty-body: Start your first search with a registration plate and the part you need.

new.title: Find the part.
new.description: Enter a registration plate and the part you need. Your result will stay in the shared search queue.
new.plate-hint: Enter a registration plate with 4–8 letters or numbers.
new.plate-error: Enter a valid registration plate with 4–8 letters or numbers.
new.part-hint: Be specific: part name and position, if known.
new.tips-body: Check the registration plate and include the part's position, such as front or rear.
new.acceptance-unknown: We couldn't confirm whether this request was accepted. Check the shared search queue before trying again to avoid creating a duplicate request.

searches.fitment: Results are identification guidance. Always confirm vehicle fitment before purchase.
searches.result-description: Your request, vehicle identification and reference matches.
searches.awaiting-results: References will appear when the search finishes.
searches.no-references: No original references are available for this request.
searches.company-history: History remains company-owned, across Web and WhatsApp.

running.title: Your search is in progress.
running.body: We're identifying the vehicle and looking for matching parts. This page updates automatically.

results.title: Reference matches found.
results.body: Check the original reference and vehicle fitment. Prices and supplier availability are not provided.

vehicle_not_found.title: We couldn't identify this vehicle.
vehicle_not_found.body: Check the registration plate and start a new search. Coverage depends on the vehicle catalogue.

not_matched.title: No matching part was found.
not_matched.body: Try a more specific description, including the part's position.

failed.title: This search couldn't be completed.
failed.body: The catalogue service could not finish the request. You can start a new search.

unavailable.title: These result details are no longer available.
unavailable.body: The request is saved in your history, but its catalogue details could not be retrieved. Start a new search to request current results.
